title: ARWP Regional Search Surface Registry
purpose: Map provider-documented regional Search experiences to explicit market, query-type and participation checks so growth work does not assume that every Search surface is globally available.

features.action: Review the provider's Aggregator unit participation and eligibility instructions for the real business before implementing any feature-specific integration.
features.verification: Confirm the company is EEA-based, the business actually acts as an aggregator for the selected query type, and all feature-specific eligibility/participation requirements are satisfied.
features.doesNotProve: Eligibility or participation does not guarantee that an Aggregator unit will appear or that the site will rank higher.

features.action: Review the provider's Supplier unit participation and eligibility instructions for the real direct supplier before implementing any feature-specific integration.
features.verification: Confirm the company is EEA-based, directly supplies the selected offering, and satisfies the current feature-specific requirements.
features.doesNotProve: Eligibility or participation does not guarantee a Supplier unit appearance or higher organic ranking.

features.action: Review the Ecosystem carousel participation requirements only when the site supplies genuine interactive/data content for the selected query type.
features.verification: Confirm the company is EEA-based, exposes a real relevant data/content service, and meets the current provider participation requirements.
features.doesNotProve: Participation does not guarantee carousel inclusion, traffic, citation, or ranking improvement.

features.action: Review the Job sites feature eligibility and participation path for a genuine job aggregator/site rather than creating job-shaped pages solely for Search exposure.
features.verification: Confirm the company is EEA-based, the site genuinely provides job listings/aggregation, and the current feature requirements are met.
features.doesNotProve: Feature eligibility does not guarantee carousel or refinement-chip inclusion.

features.action: Review the Places sites feature requirements for a genuine Türkiye-based places/hotel/local-business aggregation service.
features.verification: Confirm the company is based in Türkiye, matches the supported query type and business role, and satisfies current provider requirements.
features.doesNotProve: Feature eligibility does not guarantee placement in the Places sites carousel or refinement chip.

features.feature: South Africa badge and refinement chip
features.action: Review the South Africa badge/refinement eligibility instructions for the real business and supported query type.
features.verification: Confirm the business is South Africa-based and satisfies the current feature-specific requirements for the selected query type.
features.doesNotProve: Eligibility does not guarantee a badge/refinement appearance or organic ranking improvement.

features.action: Use the feature-specific structured-data carousel documentation only for a real list-like page whose visible entities and facts support the required markup.
features.verification: Confirm EEA company base, supported query type, feature-specific structured-data validity, visible-fact parity, canonical/indexable host page, and any additional provider eligibility requirements.
features.doesNotProve: Valid structured data makes a page eligible for the feature; it does not guarantee a rich result or higher ranking.

features.action: Use the feature-specific structured-data carousel documentation only when the site has genuine list/entity content for a supported South African query type.
features.verification: Confirm South Africa company base, supported query type, valid feature-specific markup, visible-fact parity, canonical/indexable host page, and current provider eligibility requirements.
features.doesNotProve: Valid structured data is an eligibility condition, not a rich-result or ranking guarantee.

features.action: Use the feature-specific structured-data carousel documentation only when the site has genuine list/entity content for a supported Türkiye query type.
features.verification: Confirm Türkiye company base, supported query type, valid feature-specific markup, visible-fact parity, canonical/indexable host page, and current provider eligibility requirements.
features.doesNotProve: Valid structured data is an eligibility condition, not a rich-result or ranking guarantee.
